facts.fact: PAFEN's call for expressions of interest, deadline 30 November 2023, refers to Burundi's current National ICT Development Policy (PNDTIC) and its 2011-2025 action plan, to be evaluated.
The call gives the current PNDTIC action plan's period as 2011-2025.

The call says the PNDTIC has an action plan for 2011-2025 with overall objectives the government set, whose attainment the consultancy is to evaluate; a new policy and action plan for 2025-2034 are to be drafted.
